candidate_sentences.text: AS Tallinna Sadam Group’s 2025 performance improved overall despite a slight decline in revenue.

Adjusted EBITDA grew 6.4% to EUR 56.5 million, lifting the margin from 44.4% to 47.6%.
Profit for the year rose 17.3% to EUR 22.5 million, while earnings per share increased from EUR 0.07 to EUR 0.09.
The Group invested EUR 33.2 million, down 14% year on year, including completion of the new multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour.
Operating cash flow increased to EUR 53.7 million, cash ended at EUR 32.0 million, and net debt fell 15.5% to EUR 141.7 million.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The summary begins with an overall performance assessment, then details revenue changes and their drivers, followed by expense breakdowns, profit metrics, operational volumes, segment performances, investment activity, and cash flow results. The relationships between revenue decline, expense reduction, and profit growth are clearly explained. All numerical changes are consistently framed within their operational context. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the information is organized to form a logical narrative from top-line performance to bottom-line results. No arithmetic relationships are presented as exhaustive additive components that would trigger reconciliation concerns under the specified safeguards.
